sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Billiard Classic is a simple yet challenging game. The gameplay mechanics are easy to learn, but difficult to master. Here's a breakdown of how the game works:

When you start a new game, you'll be presented with a clean billiards table. Your goal is to pocket the balls as quickly as possible without hitting the rails. Sounds easy, right? The catch is that each attempt is timed, and the faster you play, the higher your score will be. But be warned - the game gets increasingly difficult as you progress.

The game features three types of shots: cue ball shots, object ball shots, and combinations. Cue ball shots involve hitting the cue ball to strike an object ball, while object ball shots involve hitting an object ball directly. Combinations involve hitting two or more object balls with a single shot. The key to success lies in mastering these shots and combining them to achieve high scores.

But what really sets Billiard Classic apart is its unique power-ups system. As you play, you'll unlock special power-ups that give you an advantage over your opponents. These power-ups can be used strategically to boost your score or overcome obstacles. The power-ups add a whole new level of depth to the game, making it even more challenging and rewarding.
